```plato

    //==
    // # CircularSegment
    //
    // The region between the chord and the arc it subtends.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circular_segment

    // The chord endpoint at the start of the sweep.
    ChordStart(s: CircularSegment): Point2D
        => s.Circle.Center
            + Vector2D(s.Sweep.Start.Cos, s.Sweep.Start.Sin) * s.Circle.Radius;
```
